examples.title: Use an explicit input, algorithm, seed, and bucket count
Grow the treatment group without changing the hash contract
examples.sql:
SELECT user_id, bucket,
  CASE WHEN bucket < 20 THEN 'treatment' ELSE 'control' END AS rollout_20,
  CASE WHEN bucket < 50 THEN 'treatment' ELSE 'control' END AS rollout_50
FROM assignments ORDER BY user_id;

challenge.title: Find users newly included by the larger rollout
challenge.prompt: Return user_id and bucket for users who move from control at 20% to treatment at 50%.
challenge.hint: Their bucket must be at least 20 and less than 50. Already-treated users should not be counted again.
challenge.starter: SELECT user_id, bucket FROM assignments WHERE bucket < 50 ORDER BY user_id;
challenge.solution: SELECT user_id, bucket FROM assignments WHERE bucket >= 20 AND bucket < 50 ORDER BY user_id;
challenge.success: Only the newly covered interval changes groups. Existing treatment users remain in treatment when this threshold grows.
